data.name: Eemanah
data.gender_notes: Eemanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eemanah is derived from the Arabic word 'Eeman', meaning faith or belief. It signifies a strong connection to Islamic values. The name Eemanah carries the meaning “Faith and Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Eemanah usually hope their child will grow to embody faith and belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, 'Eeman' is used to describe the believers, those who have faith in Allah and His Messenger.
data.etymology: Eemanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith and Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eemanah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
